_comment: Known-stale evidence, waived explicitly rather than silently. .github/scripts/check_evidence_formats.py fails on any report whose recorded input hash no longer matches the committed input ('staleness is failure', klayout-tools docs/design-evidence-tiers.md). An entry here downgrades one such failure to a loud note -- and only that one: the waiver names the exact report, the exact check, and the exact stale hash. It SELF-EXPIRES: once the evidence is regenerated, the recorded_hash below no longer matches and the checker fails until the entry is deleted. Every entry must name a tracking issue. Waiving without one is a schema error, not a judgement call.

waivers.reason: issue #561 step 1 re-derived the SG13G2 rppd/rhigh reference values from the PDK's own rppd.sym/rhigh.sym formulas, reformatting the formula-path values at six decimals; this report's verdict (match, 0 errors) is unaffected -- bandgap_startup carries no compare_parameters, so no compared value moved -- but its committed mint predates the new reference bytes. Re-mint is step 2 (the issue's atomic DR-0016 0.8.0 re-mint), which deletes this self-expiring entry.

issue #561 step 1 re-derived the 257 rppd reference values from the PDK's own rppd.sym formula (plus rhigh at six decimals), which is the fix step for this report's own dominant finding (the 517 device.unmatched / 500 net.unmatched rppd pairing cascade, klayout-tools#6313); re-minting the report against the fixed reference is step 2 (the issue's atomic DR-0016 0.8.0 re-mint), which deletes this self-expiring entry.
